engine.scope: Generic month-end investment arithmetic; this explicit profile applies a token-based API-cost-substitution scenario.

profile.name: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash
profile.status: Illustrative budget and service-capacity assumptions; not a quote or hardware benchmark

assumptions.demandUnit: Input and output tokens per month, separately specified
assumptions.status: Illustrative budgets and capacities, not a quote or hardware benchmark
assumptions.month: 30 days; peak 154h = 22 illustrative non-holiday workdays × 7h; off-peak 566h
assumptions.capacity: Input/output rates must be simultaneously achieved for the specified workload and SLO. Proportional bucket routing uses the tighter token constraint and cannot predict real scheduling or bursts. CapacityMultiplier scales both rates together.
assumptions.availability: Uniform arrivals independent of downtime: f = a × min(1, inputCapacity/inputDemand, outputCapacity/outputDemand). Ignore zero-demand dimensions; both zero process nothing. Downtime traffic falls back immediately; headroom is applied once.
assumptions.unconstrainedThresholds: Hold 4:1 input/output mix and bucket shares fixed; ignore congestion but retain downtime fallback. Demand multipliers reference 24B input / 6B output monthly.
assumptions.apiCache: Input-token-weighted API hit fraction affects billing, never local input-capacity demand. It is not local prefix caching.
assumptions.fallbackCache: Null follows apiCacheHit; an explicit value prices fallback independently. cachePenalty is the signed extra fallback bill relative to baseline caching.
assumptions.variableCost: Per-million local input/output costs are additional to monthlyOpex; do not duplicate electricity or labor already included. opexAnnualGrowth scales fixed costs and these per-token rates. Routing stays local-first.
assumptions.output: Includes all billed thinking output once; no image workload assumed
assumptions.capitalAllocation: (capex − residual)/horizon and capex/horizon are comparison references, not extra cash expenses
assumptions.residual: Final-month expected sale proceeds; included in terminal cash/NPV, never operating payback
assumptions.capexSensitivity: Optional initial-investment reduction keeps absolute residual fixed
assumptions.investmentLimits: maxInitialInvestment holds residual fixed; proportional resale is solved jointly. idealServiceCeiling assumes zero service costs/fallback and is not attainable revenue.
assumptions.scope: No financing, taxes, replacement CapEx, price elasticity or service-quality change modeled. Horizon and independent input/output/cost growth are adjustable.

saturationEnvelope.assumptions: Fixed simultaneous token capacities, 4:1 input/output mix, 50/50 bucket splits, default prices and costs, equal baseline/fallback cache hit rates, sufficient external API capacity.

rental.monthlyRateDefinition: R is complete recurring rental-service cost: node, energy, network, storage, maintenance, software and operations; excludes separately billed fallback. Ownership OpEx is replaced, never added again.
rental.serviceAssumptions: Same simultaneously attainable token rates, availability, token workload, quality, routing and fallback as ownership. Conditional on service validation; not a quote.

fragilityHigh.assumptions: One-at-a-time changes; all other default parameters fixed. Zero-NPV boundaries are not statistically justified safety margins.

immediateApiPriceReduction.definition: Every hit, miss and output tariff in both buckets falls immediately by the same fraction and stays flat through the horizon; both baseline and fallback bills change.

minimumCapacityMultiplier.definition: Scales both jointly attainable rates before headroom and availability; not independent peak capacities.

minimumFallbackCacheHit.definition: Input-token-weighted fallback cache hit fraction; all-API baseline stays at 75%.

stressesHigh.definitions: API prices compound at 0.7^((month-1)/12). Demand reduction is one change to 51.2B input / 12.8B output per month, not repeated monthly decline.
